caption:
Stock market news | Flipkart CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy Exits Amid Delayed IPO

Flipkart Chief Executive Officer Kalyan Krishnamurthy is leaving the company after more than ten years. He became Group CEO after founders Sachin Bansal and Binny Bansal exited following the sale to Walmart. His final day at Flipkart will be 4 December 2026.
